## 席位核对 — REWORK · repo:objectstack#3 · head a90612da · 2026-11-24T02:27Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: `a90612daa3a4ba6236d206a65d1b7afc4cd1c26a`
Reviewer: L1-a (area ux-C, card #36235, claim 7118537288, os-dev-report 7120060153)

### Read
- `l1-face.mjs --pr 36812` at this head: CLEAN, 13 items. Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36235`, no other card bound, changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` plus `@object-ui/console`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true` and ships inside the console. `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim. Checks: 42 success / 13 expected skip / 0 failed, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success.
- Scope: all 8 files sit inside the claim's surface (`RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx`, their tests, changeset). The three existing pins that asserted the in-flight `#L-1` / `#T-1` assert the card's defect, so flipping them is in scope. No contract face, no governed path.
- Premise split, checked on `main`: the full page's crumb already names the object while the read is in flight (objectstack#35412 `recordCrumbName`, existing pin), and the body is `SkeletonDetail`. The drawer's record row (`titleOf(current)` → `#shortId`) and the related-list badge (`relatedData.length` = 0 during the first read) are the live halves, and the PR changes exactly those two.
- Changeset read sentence by sentence: true at this head. No new UI string: the pending tooltip reuses `detail.viewAll`, which exists in `en.ts` and `zh-Hans.ts`.
- Related-list half: `countPending` = no count answers, first read in flight, no rows, no windowed total. A compact card out of view stays pending because `loading` starts `true` (`useState(() => !!api && !dataProvided)`). An empty read still draws 0, pinned by the CONTROL case. Ablation A turns both pending cases red with the CONTROL green.
- Tests: real commands and output, two ablations, both restored to blob == HEAD. Browser reach was not measured, which the dev declared; the jsdom pins mount the real `RecordStackDrawer` with an embedded `RecordDetailView` and a deferred `findOne`.

### Findings

- **S1 (drawer title never settles when the read does not land).** `recordDrawerStack.tsx` now draws the `Skeleton` (`data-record-drawer-title-pending`) whenever `knownTitleOf(current)` is empty. Only `RecordDetailView`'s `paneRecordTitle` effect fills it: `recordTitle || (holdsRouteRecord && recordCrumbName ? recordCrumbName : undefined)`. `reportTitle` drops an `undefined` title (`if (!currentObject || !title) return;`). So a drawer whose read ends without a record never gets a title: `pageRecordStatus` `missing`, `forbidden`, `accessEnded` or `failed`, and also the object-not-found and named-page-refused branches. In all of these `holdsRouteRecord` is false, and a root level opened from a list row carries no `title`. The body draws "Record not found" (or forbidden/failed) while the bar's title shimmers as if still loading, with no end. On `main` that row read `#<shortId>`. The card asks for a placeholder **during load**; this round leaves one after the load has ended. Fix: once the page has settled without the record, report a settled name, for example the same object label `recordCrumbName` already resolves when the page does not hold the record (the page's crumb uses it today). Alternatively, draw the placeholder only while the page reports a read in flight. Pin it with a drawer test where `findOne` answers "no record": after the read settles there is no `[data-record-drawer-title-pending]` and no `#<id>` in the bar.

- **N1 (disclosed in the body).** A list that already shows 0 and refetches (for example after a row is added elsewhere) hides its badge for the length of the refetch, because `relatedData.length === 0 && loading`. A brief flicker, no false number. Small user effect, for the seat's report.
- **N2.** The browser reach reading (throttled network, page and drawer) was not taken. The jsdom pins cover both halves through the real components, and the S1 round is a good moment to take it if the verify lock is free.
- **N3 (disclosed).** Trail ancestors opened by a deep link and never drawn keep `#shortId`. They are never read, so this is not a load state, and it sits outside the card. No user effect worth a card.

Delta read owed on the next head: S1 plus a check that nothing else moved.
